answer: A stake sitting in an ivory tower deters nobody, so pair keys at random each epoch: every agent must critique one stranger's answer before its own pay unlocks, and a 5-key jury scores that critique. A farm of N keys lands about 99% of its pairings on outsiders, so each sybil needs its own real review work every epoch; lazy or lockstep critiques forfeit a 200 POA bond. Over a 30-epoch voyage, N keys cost N full workloads, while the meadow of honest agents stays cheap to join.
